summary: Sample `devfile.yaml` (schemaVersion 2.2.2) for an Ansible workspace: a tooling-container using `registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-tech-preview/ansible-devspaces-rhel9:latest` with memory and CPU limits, `ANSIBLE_COLLECTIONS_PATH` and `KUBEDOCK_ENABLED`.
questions: Example devfile.yaml for Ansible development workspaces
Which image does the Ansible devfile use?
How do I set memory limits for an Ansible workspace?

answer_card.title: devfile.yaml for an Ansible workspace
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
schemaVersion: 2.2.2
metadata:
  name: ansible-devspaces-devfile
components:
  - name: tooling-container
    container:
      image: registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-tech-preview/ansible-devspaces-rhel9:latest
      memoryRequest: 256M
      memoryLimit: 6Gi
      cpuRequest: 250m
      cpuLimit: 2000m
      args: ["tail", "-f", "/dev/null"]
      env:
        - name: ANSIBLE_COLLECTIONS_PATH
          value: "~/.ansible/collections:/usr/share/ansible/collections"
        - name: KUBEDOCK_ENABLED
          value: "true"
```
Commit it to the root of the workspace repository and push.
